_page_meta.title: Pranav PT — Bringing Technology Closer to Humans
_page_meta.description: A Finance professional who taught himself Python, built 20+ tools, and grew a community of 6,000+ learners. This is his space to share everything.

headline.line_2: It was just never explained right.

sections.subheadline: I'm a Finance professional who taught himself Python, built tools, and proved that coders are not a different breed. This is my space to explore technology — together.

visual.alt: Simplified layered technology diagram — like an exploded view of how systems are built

sections._dev_note: Two-column on desktop (text left, stats right), stacked on mobile. Stats use large Manrope numbers. The 'Read full story' link should feel like a quiet invitation, not a CTA button.
sections.title: A non-coder who taught himself to build.
sections.body: I started as a Chartered Accountant who thought Excel was powerful enough. Then I discovered VBA, then Python, then Git — and realized the entire world of technology was learnable. I've been teaching that realization ever since.

sections._dev_note: Horizontal scroll of 4 milestone cards on mobile. Fixed row of 4 on desktop. Each card has: date tag, short title, and an emotion/tag label. Last item is 'Today'. After the cards, a quiet link to /about#journey.
sections.title: From Excel to Python. From user to builder.
sections.subtitle: It didn't happen overnight. Here are the moments that changed everything.
